description: Copies the style — and optionally the size — of a single node into the static DiagramClipboard. Unlike the other diagram commands it does not implement IDiagramCommand and has no Undo(), because it changes no document state; execute it directly instead of pushing it onto a DiagramCommandStack.

members.name: Execute
members.description: Stores the node's style (and size when includeSize is true) in DiagramClipboard.
